channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Avalon at Mission Bay III (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Avalon at Mission Bay III: Avalon at Mission Bay III: AvalonBay's release of June 18, 2009 says it was celebrating the grand opening that day with an evening ceremony; it does not say when residents moved in.

item.title: Correction · Avalon at Mission Bay III: The map notes said the parcel's many per-unit condo lots share its footprint; the DataSF parcel data has only the parcel itself, so the claim was replaced with a correction. The 353-383 King St address and 260 units now cite the DataSF Assessor roll, the 'three phases along King St' note was reduced to what AvalonBay's release says, the 2009 grand-opening milestone links the release, and the 2007 milestone links the SocketSite post and no longer says the building topped out.
item.description: The map notes said the parcel's many per-unit condo lots share its footprint; the DataSF parcel data has only the parcel itself, so the claim was replaced with a correction. item.title: Milestone · Avalon at Mission Bay III: DBI recorded new-construction permit 200105300277 (17 stories, 260 dwellings, 353/383 King St) as completed. This is the permit's closure date, not an opening date. (Aug 14, 2009)
item.description: DBI recorded new-construction permit 200105300277 (17 stories, 260 dwellings, 353/383 King St) as completed. This is the permit's closure date, not an opening date. (Aug 14, 2009). Source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection, via DataSF.

item.title: Complete · Avalon at Mission Bay III: Grand opening celebrated: AvalonBay's release of June 18, 2009 says it "today is celebrating the grand opening of Avalon at Mission Bay III" and will host a ceremony there "this evening". The release was written the same day, before the ceremony, and does not say when residents moved in or leasing began. (Jun 18, 2009)
item.description: Grand opening celebrated: AvalonBay's release of June 18, 2009 says it "today is celebrating the grand opening of Avalon at Mission Bay III" and will host a ceremony there "this evening". The release was written the same day, before the ceremony, and does not say when residents moved in or leasing began. (Jun 18, 2009). Source: AvalonBay Communities, 2009-06-18.
